architecture_decision.justification: Separate the long-lived connection path from the request-response API so the two can scale and roll out independently at 5000 peak concurrent users.
data_flow: Route HTTP requests and authenticated socket upgrades to separate application services.

tradeoffs: Independent gateway scaling adds a deployment and coordination path. Benchmark hot rooms because shared fanout can duplicate work.

supporting.justification: Broker an approved OIDC identity provider and keep application roles in the local realm. Deploy the identity realm and its database in the selected region. Use a separate logical database or schema with its own account on the selected relational platform.

alternatives.why_not: An external directory adds an account and an independent data plane.

tradeoffs: Account lifecycle, recovery and federation scopes require explicit configuration.

supporting.justification: Use a private bucket in the same region as the API with short-lived signed uploads and encryption.

alternatives.why_not: Independent object retention and direct upload reduce transactional I/O.

tradeoffs: Lifecycle rules and egress need budgeting and review.

supporting.justification: Authorize each document and store binary Yjs state through the Database extension. Use the Redis extension with regional Valkey for cross-instance fanout. Test the persistence interval and reconnect behavior.

alternatives.why_not: Transport alone does not resolve concurrent document edits.

tradeoffs: Fanout delivers each update to the other instances. Hot-room load and the interval between durable writes need measurement.

supporting.justification: Use region-local pub/sub for cross-replica fanout. Keep persistent events and snapshots in the database.

alternatives.why_not: Independent replicas need shared fanout or cache state.

tradeoffs: Pub/sub is ephemeral. Bound memory and provision failover separately.

supporting.justification: Buffer asynchronous work outside request handling using acknowledgements, bounded retries and dead-letter queues.

alternatives.why_not: A separate broker isolates higher-volume background work from database read paths.

tradeoffs: Assume at-least-once delivery and make all handlers idempotent.

supporting.justification: Tokenize payment details via hosted checkout. Verify webhook signatures and reconcile settlement against local records.

alternatives.why_not: Hosted collection reduces card-data exposure and audit scope.

tradeoffs: Country eligibility, merchant underwriting, fees and processor data scope require approval.

supporting.justification: Record request percentiles, saturation, errors and queue lag locally. Redact payloads before collection.

alternatives.why_not: Self-operated telemetry keeps operational data within the selected boundary.

tradeoffs: Manage log/metric cardinality, retention and actionable alerts.

supporting.justification: Build and scan signed images on an approved runner, keeping artifacts and credentials in the boundary.

alternatives.why_not: A public runner is outside the selected boundary.

tradeoffs: Pin actions and lock deployment credentials to the minimum scope.

assumptions: Illustrative monthly USD operating band. Inputs are sizing proxies, not a measured request or billing forecast.
Peak proxy: 5000 concurrent clients, 3000 requests or realtime events per second and 200 GB total data.
Placement: eu-central-1 (Frankfurt). Starts with modest regional capacity and backups.
Excludes taxes, team labor, initial hardware, domain purchases and transaction fees. Media and OTP allowances are modeled separately when requested.
Heavy internet egress is outside the baseline. Provide a monthly estimate to price it explicitly.

warnings.message: Document data flows, a DPA, erasure/export and retention. If any processor or support plane transfers data, verify the applicable transfer mechanism.
The upper monthly estimate exceeds the budget. Meter workloads, enforce usage alerts and verify the region-specific bill.
Before going live, verify processor coverage for the requested country and rails and confirm any data residency or compliance obligations in the processor agreement.

budget_alternative.method: Rerun the same inputs with a hard cap on the modeled upper monthly cost.

new_tradeoffs.message: Plan for WebSocket reconnects before the Cloud Run request timeout. Share room state between instances, test reconnect storms and verify billing while sockets are open.
